summary: Kamada Ltd., an Israeli biopharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K announcing it will release Q2 and first-half 2026 financial results on August 12, 2026, before U.S. market open, followed by a conference call at 8:30 am ET. The filing includes dial-in details, webcast link, and a company overview describing its portfolio of plasma-derived products, controlling shareholder FIMI Opportunity Funds (approx. 38% ownership), and growth strategy. This is a routine earnings announcement notice, not a special-situation transaction. The registrant is the issuer providing a standard scheduling update with no deal terms, board actions, or strategic developments. What to watch: ordinary earnings release scheduled for August 12, 2026.
